name: Quadriceps Set
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg extended in front of you and the other in a comfortable position.
Tighten the front of the extended thigh and press the back of the knee gently toward the floor.
Hold the contraction while breathing normally, then relax your thigh and switch legs.
tips: Keep the heel in contact with the floor throughout the hold.
Look for the kneecap to draw slightly toward your hip as the thigh tightens.
